title: fix(service-automation): a screen-flow resume refuses a non-string value for a text-like field before the pause is consumed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9QaksZP89FVq2pH6CVzsEb)_

Fixes #31491

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：屏幕流程恢复时，`text`、`textarea`、`email`、`url`、`phone` 五种字段收到非字符串值（对象、数字、布尔、数组）一律在消费暂停之前拒绝 400 `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`，运行保持暂停，改正后再提交即可完成。
- 为什么改：按裁定 A+（卡片评论 6721960676）。修改前，对象值在暂停已被消费后才在写记录时失败，运行变成 failed，改正后的恢复只得到 `RUN_NOT_FOUND`；数字则被当成文本存下。
- 风险与回滚：这是收紧（narrowing），只判断类型，不判断邮箱、网址、电话的格式；缺失值的行为不变。无头调用（MCP `run_action`）给这类字段传非字符串时，屏幕改为保持交互，与数字字段现有做法一致。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.ts` 中的 `isString` 和 `SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` 新增的五项。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/services/service-automation && npx vitest run src/screen-input-contract.test.ts src/builtin/screen-string-field-resume.test.ts`，预期 40 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位做契约审查后落地。

## What changes

- `screen-input-contract.ts`: `text`, `textarea`, `email`, `url` and `phone` join `SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` on one predicate, `isString` (a JSON string). A present value of another JSON type is an `invalid_type` issue, `Screen field "answer" must be a string`, and `refuseInvalidScreenInput` answers it `400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` before `claimAdvance`, so the suspension is not consumed (the #13937 order: consume before traverse, nothing consumed on a refusal).
- Only the shape is judged. The format of an email, URL or phone number, and any other downstream refusal of a string, are unchanged and keep the operator restore as their exit.
- An absent value, `null`, the empty string and a hidden field behave as today. A missing required field still yields only the `required` issue.
- The docblocks name ruling A+ next to the existing A′ and #30178 groups, and the `judgeHeadlessScreen` comment says an issue may be a wrong-shape value as well as a missing required one.
- Changesets: `@objectstack/service-automation` patch, titled with `!` and carrying the `**BREAKING**` banner, with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition (nothing at rest changes). It also names the two console paths that now stop at Submit with the run still paused: a text-kind field whose `options[].value` is a number or a boolean, and a text-kind field whose served `defaultValue` resolves to a non-string. A second `@objectstack/spec` patch docs changeset covers the contract text below.
- Contract text (prose only, as #30178 did; no accept set, schema shape or export in spec moves): the `ScreenFieldSpec.type` docblock (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`), the `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` docblock and describe string (`builtin-node-config.zod.ts`, with `content/docs/references/automation/builtin-node-config.mdx` regenerated), `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (the shape section and the list of refused conditions), and the opening of the `validateScreenInputs` docblock now name the five string kinds beside the numeric kinds and `file`.

## Tests

- `screen-input-contract.test.ts`: for each of the five kinds, an object, `42`, `0`, `true` and an array are refused `invalid_type` with the message above; any string is admitted; absent, `null`, `''` and a hidden field are left alone. A headless pin: `judgeHeadlessScreen` with `42` is not satisfied (the field is listed as supplied and missing), and the string `'42'` is satisfied.
- New `builtin/screen-string-field-resume.test.ts` (engine, start → screen → create_record → end): for each kind, an object resume and a number resume are refused `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`, nothing is inserted, and `hasSuspendedRun` stays true. A string resume then completes, is inserted, and the suspension is gone. A missing value gets the `is required` refusal and the run stays paused.
- `screen-headless-provenance-durable-resume.test.ts` and `screen-headless-caller-signal.test.ts`: their review screen field is now untyped. Those fixtures bind an ARRAY to the field, which a `text` field would now refuse for its shape, a second reason to pause that is not the provenance verdict they measure. A comment in each says so.

## Verification

<details><summary>Reproduction before the change (fresh showcase boot)</summary>

```
resume with an object for a text field   -> 400 FLOW_FAILED, run failed, corrected resume 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND
resume with 42 for a text field          -> completed, '42' stored
resume with the value missing            -> 400, run still paused
```
</details>

<details><summary>Pins and ablations</summary>

```
npx vitest run src/screen-input-contract.test.ts src/builtin/screen-string-field-resume.test.ts   Tests 40 passed (40)

ablation 1: isString admits any non-null value
 Tests  16 failed | 24 passed (40)
ablation 2: delete the phone member of SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS
 × refuses a present non-string on a `phone` field
 × leaves an absent value and a hidden `phone` field alone
 × `phone`: an object and a number are refused, the pause survives, and a corrected resume completes
 Tests  3 failed | 37 passed (40)
```
Both were run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree and restored to the HEAD blob.
</details>

<details><summary>Suite, typecheck and gates</summary>

`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, the turbo build, the full service-automation suite (`Test Files 265 passed`, `Tests 3454 passed`) and `pnpm run typecheck` all exit 0. After the contract-text round, on head 4d1aeaf3f: the spec schemas and reference docs were regenerated (`gen:schema`, `gen:docs`), the spec and service-automation builds and the full suite pass again (3454), and `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 114 families; all 114 run with each exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles: `114 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`. The first round, before the prose, derived 66, all exit 0. The ADR-0087 registration gate went red on the first run because the changeset lacked a disposition; the marker was added in its own commit and the gate, plus every changeset-reading gate, was rerun to exit 0.
</details>
